items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: So over my shoulders I have pictures of a few of my musical heroes including Cannonball Adderley, Lester Young, Count Basie.

ctx.x: Oh no, no. No. I just say what I think it is you know, I’m not a philosopher.

Well it was a compliment. So. So over my shoulders I have pictures of a few of my musical heroes including Cannonball Adderley, Lester Young, Count Basie. And I know you worked with Dinah Washington. So the music of these people may be looked at as less spiritual than the music you played with Pharoah Sanders. So I’m wondering how you think of that music in society. What is the role of that music in society?

I don’t think it’s any less spiritual. I think it’s just a different approach. Remember I mentioned earlier that it’s about adding something, taking something away, how you manage those conditions as they flow into — and conceptually these individuals are doing their thing accordingly, more or less effort, more or less intent to express, maybe not a spiritual situation but a statement that references the moment of who they are individually and collectively. As I profess, if you will initially, earlier, it can’t…
